The price shall be for the total scope as defined in this d ocument for supply of School Furniture Items for Schools of Di strict Budgam (to be identified by Chief Education Officer Con cerned) inclusive of all charges towards transportation at the de signated sites, storage of material at the designated sites, packi ng & forwarding, inspection, insurance, freight charges all centr al/ state/ local taxes & duties etc. as applicable for the supplies i ncluding five years warranty of all the parts of the equipment. 8. All applicable charges for taking statutory clearances, whereve r necessary, are included in the contract price. 9. During the period of the contract, ACD Budgam may order ad dition / deletion in quantities which the Bidder shall comply. The adjustment in Contract Price shall be made at the same unit rat e as per rate quoted. 10. The bills shall be released only after the bill is prepared by en gineering staff only. WARRANTY 11. (a) If the Bidder is found defaulter for delayed supply or fail ure to deliver satisfactory performance or supply of substandard materials etc pursuant to NIT conditions.

The supplier shall bear all the legal expenses incurred on the execu tion of the agreements. DELIVERY 15. Supply of School Furniture & Furnishing and Electrical It ems as per the enclosed quantity shall commence immediately after placing of order and all of the ordered quantity should be c ompleted within the stipulated time mentioned in LOA. 16. In case of failure to deliver in full the required supplies o n order, the purchaser shall have the right to make a risk purch ase @ 1% per day of the value on cost of supplier or/and cancel the contract and claim reasonable compensation/ damages. The contract of the supply shall be repudiated if the supplies are not made within the prescribed period and to the satisfaction of the purchasing officer. PAYMENT SCHEDULE 17. Payment will be released (Subject to availability of Funds) and rel ease to the undersigned by the Government. SECURITY Deposit 18. The successful bidders(s) shall furnish Security deposit equiva lent to 05% (Five percent) of the value of the contract in the for m of FDR/TDR from Nationalized/ Scheduled Commercial Banks i ssued in Favour of ACD Budgam for a period of 14 Month(s). NO CLAIM OR COMPENSATION FOR SUBMISSION OF TENDER 42. The bidder whose bid is not accepted shall not be entitled to claim any costs, charges, ex penses of and incidental to incurred by him through or in connection with his submissi on of bid, even though ACD Budgam may elect to withdraw the notice inviting bid. A. SPECIAL INSTRUCTIONS: 1. Bids not submitted on the lines indicated above are liable to be rejecte d without correspondence (Proforma-8). 2. The purchaser reserves the right to accept or reject the reques t for extension in the last date of receipt of bids. 3. The purchaser reserves the right to order additional quantity or reduce the quantity of the material advertised at the time of placement of order for which the quoted rates shall be valid. 4. All legal proceeding in connection with the order/bid will be subject to t he jurisdiction of local courts of Jammu and Kashmir UT alone. 5. In case of any doubt, dispute or differences arising out of the contract, the same shall be referred to the Arbitrator for arbitration to be appointed under J &K Arbitration & Conciliation Act, 1997 whose decision shall be final. 6. The contract shall be interpreted in accordance with the applicable law

s of J&K post reorganization of the erstwhile state. In case any previous law of J&K which has been repealed, existing central(s) would become applicable and govern the subject. 7. The bidder is required to submit a statement of facts in details as to th eir previous experience in performing a similar or comparable work and business and technical organization, financial resources and manufacturing facilities availa ble and to be used in performing the contract. 8. If at any time any of the documents/information submitted by the bidd er is found to be incorrect, false or untruthful, the bid and/or the resultant order m ay be summarily rejected/cancelled at the risk of the bidder. 9. ACD Budgam reserves the right to postpone the date of receipt and op ening of the bids or cancel any or all the bids without assigning reasons and with out bearing any liability thereof. 10. Force Majeur clause shall apply. 11. All the Administrative approval conditions shall apply to the contract and no co ndition from bidder side will apply. 12.
